entities.name: Paco Ibáñez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco "Paco" Ibáñez is a Spanish singer and musician. He never composed his own lyrics, but used famous poems, like those of Federico García Lorca, Luis Cernuda, Rafael Alberti or Miguel Hernández. He also sang compositions from Georges Brassens.
